## Stepper.svelte

### `interface Props`
- `backButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the Back button, so a caller can restyle or relabel it.
- `nextButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the Next / Finish button.

- `steps` :: The steps, in order.
- `value` :: The current step's value. Two-way bindable.
- `onValueChange` :: Called whenever the current step changes.
- `orientation` :: Lays the steps out in a row or a column.
- `linear` :: When true, only the current step and earlier ones can be selected.
- `clickable` :: When true, a step's marker is a button that selects it, subject to `linear`.
- `showControls` :: Render Back / Next / Finish workflow buttons underneath the stepper.
- `completedContent` :: Custom snippet displayed once all steps have been completed.
- `onComplete` :: Called when finishing the last step via `showControls`.
- `label` :: Accessible name of the stepper.
- `size` :: The height of each step's marker, which is always square.
- `shape` :: The corner treatment of the marker.
- `textSize` :: The scale of the step label and of the number inside the marker.
- `textColor` :: The ink of a step that has not been reached yet.
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of the description under a step label.
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of that description.

## steps.ts

### `type StepStatus`

Visual and semantic state of a step.

### `interface StepItem`

One step in a Stepper.

- `value` :: A stable value for this step, written to the stepper's `value` when it is current.
- `label` :: The visible title.
- `description` :: A short supporting line under the title.
- `icon` :: An icon drawn in the marker, in place of the step number or a check.
- `status` :: Overrides the derived state (complete, current, upcoming) for this step.
- `disabled` :: Prevents the step from being selected when the stepper is clickable.
